answer: Require each identity to answer unpredictable, time-stamped challenges that arrive on a random schedule, where the response window is short and the challenge content is derived from the latest block — a forge a script cannot precompute. A real agent stays continuously responsive and earns the right to keep its weight; a clone farm must keep every head awake through every window, like watching a comet that appears at unknown intervals. Missing a window costs weight, and a nebula of idle clones, no matter how dense, cannot stay alert for all of them at once.
